name: 119A - Mock - Intent and Entity Router - Credential Free

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS session_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS message_id,
        LEAST(
            GREATEST($3::INTEGER, 1),
            100
        ) AS context_message_limit
),

session_context AS (
    SELECT
        session.id AS session_id,
        session.session_key,
        session.clinic_id,
        session.patient_id,
        session.channel,
        session.external_conversation_id,
        session.status AS session_status,
        session.language,
        session.last_intent,
        session.pending_action,
        session.collected_entities,
        session.risk_flags AS session_risk_flags,
        session.context_summary,

        clinic.name AS clinic_name,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile

    FROM conversation_sessions session

    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON request.session_id = session.id

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = session.clinic_id

    LEFT JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = session.patient_id

    LIMIT 1
),

target_message AS (
    SELECT
        message.id AS message_id,
        message.session_id,
        message.direction,
        message.sender_type,
        message.message_type,
        message.content_text,
        message.content_json,
        message.created_at

    FROM conversation_messages message

    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON request.message_id = message.id
       AND request.session_id = message.session_id

    WHERE message.direction = 'inbound'

    LIMIT 1
),

recent_rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            message.id AS message_id,
            message.direction,
            message.sender_type,
            message.message_type,
            message.content_text,
            message.content_json,
            message.intent,
            message.tool_action,
            message.created_at

        FROM conversation_messages message

        INNER JOIN request_data request
            ON request.session_id = message.session_id

        ORDER BY
            message.created_at DESC,
            message.id DESC

        LIMIT (
            SELECT context_message_limit
            FROM request_data
        )
    ) recent

    ORDER BY
        recent.created_at ASC,
        recent.message_id ASC
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM session_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_message
        )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM session_context
        )
            THEN 'conversation_session_not_found'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_message
        )
            THEN 'inbound_message_not_found'

        ELSE 'ai_context_loaded'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT ROW_TO_JSON(session_context)
        FROM session_context
    ) AS session_context,

    (
        SELECT ROW_TO_JSON(target_message)
        FROM target_message
    ) AS target_message,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'message_id', message_id,
                    'direction', direction,
                    'sender_type', sender_type,
                    'message_type', message_type,
                    'content_text', content_text,
                    'content_json', content_json,
                    'intent', intent,
                    'tool_action', tool_action,
                    'created_at', created_at
                )
                ORDER BY created_at, message_id
            )
            FROM recent_rows
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS recent_messages

FROM request_data request;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS session_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS message_id,
        $3::TEXT AS intent,
        $4::NUMERIC AS confidence,
        $5::TEXT AS language,
        $6::JSONB AS entities,
        $7::JSONB AS missing_fields,
        $8::JSONB AS risk_flags,
        $9::BOOLEAN AS requires_human,
        $10::BOOLEAN AS requires_confirmation,
        $11::TEXT AS tool_action,
        NULLIF($12::TEXT, '') AS next_question,
        NULLIF($13::TEXT, '') AS reasoning_summary,
        $14::TEXT AS model_provider,
        $15::TEXT AS model_name,
        $16::TEXT AS prompt_version,
        $17::JSONB AS raw_output,
        $18::JSONB AS parsed_output,
        $19::INTEGER AS latency_ms
),

updated_message AS (
    UPDATE conversation_messages message

    SET
        intent = request.intent,
        intent_confidence = request.confidence,
        extracted_entities = request.entities,
        risk_flags = request.risk_flags,
        tool_action = request.tool_action,
        model_provider = request.model_provider,
        model_name = request.model_name

    FROM request_data request

    WHERE message.id = request.message_id
      AND message.session_id = request.session_id

    RETURNING message.id
),

updated_session AS (
    UPDATE conversation_sessions session

    SET
        language = request.language,
        last_intent = request.intent,

        pending_action = CASE
            WHEN JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(
                request.missing_fields
            ) > 0
                THEN request.tool_action

            WHEN request.requires_confirmation = TRUE
                THEN request.tool_action

            ELSE NULL
        END,

        collected_entities =
            COALESCE(
                session.collected_entities,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || request.entities,

        risk_flags = request.risk_flags,

        status = CASE
            WHEN request.requires_human = TRUE
                THEN 'waiting_human'

            WHEN JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(
                    request.missing_fields
                 ) > 0
                THEN 'waiting_patient'

            ELSE 'active'
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_data request

    WHERE session.id = request.session_id

      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM updated_message
      )

    RETURNING session.*
),

inserted_run AS (
    INSERT INTO conversation_ai_runs (
        session_id,
        input_message_id,
        model_provider,
        model_name,
        prompt_version,
        status,
        raw_output,
        parsed_output,
        latency_ms
    )

    SELECT
        request.session_id,
        request.message_id,
        request.model_provider,
        request.model_name,
        request.prompt_version,
        'success',
        request.raw_output,
        request.parsed_output,
        request.latency_ms

    FROM request_data request

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM updated_message
    )

    RETURNING id AS ai_run_id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_message
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_message
        )
            THEN 'message_or_session_not_found'

        WHEN request.tool_action =
             'urgent_human_handoff'
            THEN 'urgent_ai_route_saved'

        ELSE 'ai_route_saved'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_message
        )
            THEN 'پیام یا جلسه مکالمه پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN request.tool_action =
             'urgent_human_handoff'
            THEN 'تحلیل ثبت شد و پیام نیازمند ارجاع فوری انسانی است.'

        ELSE 'هدف، اطلاعات استخراج‌شده و مسیر بعدی ثبت شد.'
    END AS message,

    request.session_id,
    request.message_id,

    (
        SELECT ai_run_id
        FROM inserted_run
    ) AS ai_run_id,

    request.intent,
    request.confidence,
    request.language,
    request.entities,
    request.missing_fields,
    request.risk_flags,
    request.requires_human,
    request.requires_confirmation,
    request.tool_action,
    request.next_question,
    request.reasoning_summary,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS session_status,

    (
        SELECT pending_action
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS pending_action,

    (
        SELECT collected_entities
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS collected_entities,

    CASE
        WHEN request.tool_action =
             'urgent_human_handoff'
            THEN 'safety_handoff'

        WHEN request.next_question IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'ask_missing_information'

        WHEN request.requires_confirmation = TRUE
            THEN 'request_action_confirmation'

        WHEN request.tool_action <> 'none'
            THEN 'execute_tool'

        ELSE 'compose_response'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## Mock Intent Router بدون Credential

Webhook این Workflow عمداً با 106A یکسان است:
POST /webhook/clinic/ai/analyze-message

برای تست، 106A را Deactivate و این Workflow را Active کن.
در Production برعکس عمل شود.

طبقه‌بندی با قواعد قطعی انجام می‌شود و نتیجه در همان جداول Conversation ذخیره می‌شود.
